messages.content: Please check Hilton Tokyo and book a deluxe room for Jordan Lee from 2026-01-10 to 2026-01-13. After that, get the weather for Tokyo, Japan and prepare and publish a high-priority in-app weather brief and alert card for me on the app channel. Then look up headphones in the electronics category, use the Sony XM5 option with product_id p_sony_xm5_blk to generate recommendations, choose the best recommendation, and check out 1 unit. Finally, send a high-priority app notification confirming that the hotel booking, weather notice, and travel-related product purchase are complete for user_01.
